description: This PHP class defines the 'EmpUsTaxExemption' entity within the OrangeHRM system, representing employee US tax exemption details. It uses Doctrine ORM for database mapping, includes constants for various tax statuses, and provides getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemption
classes.description: Entity class representing employee US tax exemption data, including various tax status and exemption fields, with ORM annotations for database mapping.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this tax exemption record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee object with this tax exemption record.

methods.name: getFederalStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the federal tax filing status.

methods.name: setFederalStatus
methods.description: Sets the federal tax filing status.

methods.name: getFederalExemptions
methods.description: Retrieves the number of federal exemptions.

methods.name: setFederalExemptions
methods.description: Sets the number of federal exemptions.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Gets the state for tax purposes.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state for tax purposes.

methods.name: getStateExemptions
methods.description: Retrieves the number of state exemptions.

methods.name: setStateExemptions
methods.description: Sets the number of state exemptions.

methods.name: getUnemploymentState
methods.description: Gets the unemployment state for tax purposes.

methods.name: getWorkState
methods.description: Retrieves the work state for tax purposes.
